text.en: 1. This Order is the Platform Workers (Maximum Amount Payable in Priority) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 1 January 2025.

heading.en: Prescribed amount for purposes of sections 16(3), 17(3) and 18(3) of Act

text.en: 2. The prescribed amount for the purposes of sections 16(3), 17(3) and 18(3) of the Act is $13,000 for each platform worker.
